title: Upgrade network to v8.2.0
summary:
If passed, this proposal will upgrade the blockchain to version 8.2.0. # v8.2.0 Upgrade Summary

Validators must build with Go 1.26.x. Module migrations: rewards v4→v5 (Denom Rewards parameter defaults) and txfeecollector v2→v3 (empty inbound IBC block list); no store keys added or removed.

## Highlights

- **Denom Rewards**: anyone can create a reward that pays any token to the stakers of any token, with scheduled daily payouts and airdrops.
- **TokenFactory**: denom branding (name, symbol, logo, links) managed by the denom admin, and renouncing denom admin rights.
- **TradeBin**: governance can halt a denom, which makes it unswappable in every pool and route.
- **Staking rewards**: a finished staking reward can be removed by anyone once all stakes have exited.
- **TxFeeCollector**: `--gas auto` now works with `--gas-prices`, including non-native fee denoms.
- **Dependencies**: CometBFT v0.38.26.

## Noble USDC wind-down

Circle is retiring USDC on Noble, so from 2027-01-12 the USDC.n vouchers on BeeZee lose their backing. At the upgrade height the chain stops accepting new inbound `uusdc` from Noble (exits stay open) and transfers the protocol-owned USDC.n/BZE liquidity-pool shares held by the burner black hole to the team's admin address `bze1jx4x3kn8mlz2s03zdpf2a38x9gl66llvjqdd55`, so that liquidity can be migrated to Injective-issued USDC (USDC.inj) and locked in the black hole again as a USDC.inj/BZE pool. Every other black-hole balance stays where it is.
